newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO BEAT SPORTING TO GO TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO BEAT SPORTING TO GO TOP.

text.p: A goal by Brazilian winger Edmilson Pimenta was enough to give Porto victory over perennial rivals Sporting in a Portuguese first division clash on Saturday and extend the champions' unbeaten run against the Lisbon side to seven years.
The win took Porto to the top of the league, although perhaps only for 24 hours because Benfica can overtake them if they win away against Salgueiros on Sunday.
Pimenta scored in the 26th minute with a header after defender Paulinho Santos crossed from the right.

Sporting, who have not even scored against Porto for four seasons, could have taken the lead in the first minute but captain Oceano Cruz' fiercely-struck free kick came crashing back off the crossbar.
Oceano had another chance to level the scores in injury time but his shot rolled wide of the post with Porto's 19-year-old goalkeeper Henrique Hilario well-beaten.
Porto, who face Norwegian champions Rosenborg on Wednesday in the European Champions League, have 14 points, one more than Sporting, Espinho and Benfica.
